features.name: Mechanical promotion into memory/shared/ (v1)
features.behavior: node harness-loop/scripts/memory-promote.mjs --target DIR writes a memory/shared/facts.md entry when the same normalized checkerNotes-first-line or trace `detail` recurs across >=2 features/occurrences, and at least one source has evidence type test or tool-output. Never promotes from evidence:inference alone.
features.falsifier: memory-promote.mjs promotes from a single occurrence (violates [INV-PROMOTE-1]), promotes when every source is evidence:inference (violates [INV-SHARED-1]), or writes something other than a templated entry citing its sources.

context.note: v1 scope only (docs/design/shared-memory-tier.md INV-PROMOTE-1) — reuses memory-consolidate.mjs --bootstrap's exact recurrence detection, adds evidence-typed mechanical writing. Free-text matching is v2, not this feature.

features.name: README.md standardized for new users
features.behavior: README.md presents a clear structure: what the harness does, where to start, how to extend it, important files, and examples. Each section has its own heading. A first-time reader understands its value and use within two minutes.
features.falsifier: README.md remains a single paragraph without headings, lacks quick-start guidance, or does not explain how to extend the harness.

context.note: Change only README.md. Do not change any other behavior. Base the content on the existing SKILL.md, AGENTS.md, and docs/INDEX.md.

evidence.result: FAIL: Expected at least 5 level-2 headings, found 1 - README had only one heading before standardization
PASS: README has 5 structured sections with required content

features.checkerNotes: ACCEPTED: README.md was standardized into five clear sections with complete content. The verification command was fixed to check README.md independently, without depending on repository state. Evidence includes a complete red→green run. The reviewPacket meets every admission criterion.

features.falsifier: Prompts live in two different directories (loop/ and prompts/), the manifest points to a nonexistent path, or gen-agents generates an agent without a prompt.

context.note: Move maker-prompt.md and checker-prompt.md from loop/ to prompts/. Update both the template and the dogfood target.

evidence: prompts/maker.md and prompts/checker.md exist; loop/maker-prompt.md and loop/checker-prompt.md were removed. agents.manifest.json has 9 'prompts/' lines and 0 'loop/*-prompt' lines. demo.sh is green.
features.reviewPacket: Prompts moved from loop/ to prompts/. The manifest, verify-harness, check-coverage, and demo.sh were all updated. The template tree is synchronized.

features.name: Harness uses Claude Code ACP with claude-opus-4-6
features.behavior: dispatch.mjs prioritizes the Claude Code runtime. All agents run on the claude-opus-4-6 model. Kiro agents remain but are no longer the default runtime.
features.verification: HARNESS_RUNTIME=claude node loop/dispatch.mjs maker --dry-run 2>&1 | grep -q claude
features.falsifier: dispatch.mjs still chooses Kiro before Claude, or agents run on a model other than claude-opus-4-6.

context.note: Use claude-opus-4-6 for every agent. Set HARNESS_RUNTIME=claude in run-loop.mjs.

evidence: agents.manifest.json: every agent uses claude-opus-4-6. run-loop.mjs defaults HARNESS_RUNTIME=claude. .claude/agents/*.md generates the correct model. demo.sh is green.
features.reviewPacket: claude-opus-4-6 is used for eight agents. run-loop.mjs sets HARNESS_RUNTIME=claude when no environment value exists. Kiro agents remain with the new prompt path.

features.name: Prove: prompt centralization and Claude Code ACP work end-to-end
features.behavior: A scaffolded target generates agents from prompts/, dispatches through Claude Code runtime, and the demo exercises the full path without referencing the old loop/*-prompt layout.
features.falsifier: gen-agents produces an agent referencing loop/*-prompt.md, or dispatch.mjs falls back to Kiro when HARNESS_RUNTIME is unset.

context.note: Prove counterpart for feat-prompt-centralize and feat-claude-code-acp. One prove judges both because they share the same verification path.

evidence.result: Oracle được tạo với 6 điều kiện kiểm tra độc lập: tập trung prompt, không còn legacy path, gen-agents tạo config đúng, dispatch chọn claude runtime, không fallback về kiro, và demo chạy thành công end-to-end

features.name: test-toolchain.json schema and validator
features.behavior: schemas/test-toolchain.schema.json validates the test-toolchain/1 format. tools/validate-toolchain.mjs reads a project's test-toolchain.json, validates it against the schema, checks requires conditions, and reports scope/size/command for each declared scope.
features.falsifier: The validator accepts a toolchain with a missing command field, an invalid size value, or a requires entry referencing a nonexistent scope.

context.note: Design doc: docs/design/pluggable-test-toolchain.md. Schema version test-toolchain/1. Scope names: unit|component|contract|journey|e2e|snapshot|lint|typecheck|build.

features.name: resolve-test-command.mjs resolves scope to command
features.behavior: tools/resolve-test-command.mjs reads test-toolchain.json and returns the command for a given --scope, the scopes and commands for a given --feature (using testScope), or the full command list for a given --profile. --check-requires reports skipped scopes.
features.falsifier: The script returns a command for a scope whose requires are not met, or returns nothing when the toolchain declares the scope with a valid command.

context.note: Reads test-toolchain.json (project root or harness/). Placeholder expansion: {file} and {name} in focused commands. Falls back gracefully when no toolchain exists.

features.name: init.mjs reads test-toolchain.json for baseline
features.behavior: When test-toolchain.json exists, init.mjs reads its baseline array and runs each scope's command in order, skipping scopes whose requires are not met. When no toolchain exists, init.mjs falls back to the current stack-detection logic.
features.falsifier: init.mjs ignores a present test-toolchain.json and runs the hardcoded verification block, or it fails when test-toolchain.json is absent instead of falling back.

context.note: The VERIFICATION block between >>> and <<< markers is replaced by toolchain-reading logic. Template init.mjs gets the same change. Scaffolder still writes the fallback block for projects without a toolchain.

features.name: feature_list.json supports testScope field
features.behavior: review-contract.mjs validates that a feature's testScope (string or array) references only scopes declared in test-toolchain.json. The feature template includes testScope. When testScope is absent, defaultTestScope from the toolchain applies.
features.falsifier: review-contract.mjs accepts a feature with testScope referencing a scope not in the toolchain, or rejects a feature when no toolchain exists.

context.note: testScope is metadata for checker scope-match validation. Does not replace the verification string. Backward compatible: absent testScope uses defaultTestScope; absent toolchain makes testScope inert.

features.name: survey-project.mjs detects test runners and suggests toolchain
features.behavior: survey-project.mjs detects installed test runners (vitest, jest, playwright, cypress, pact, pytest, junit/maven, go test, cargo test) from manifests and devDependencies, and includes a suggestedToolchain object in its --json output.
features.falsifier: survey-project.mjs reports no runner for a project whose package.json lists vitest in devDependencies, or invents a runner not evidenced by any manifest file.

context.note: Detection is evidence-based: every runner must cite the file it was found in. suggestedToolchain is a draft — the human confirms before committing.

features.name: check-quality-strategy.mjs validates scope against toolchain
features.behavior: When test-toolchain.json exists, check-quality-strategy.mjs warns if a risk's requiredScope has no matching scope in the toolchain. The existing scope/size validation rules remain unchanged.
features.falsifier: check-quality-strategy.mjs stays silent when a risk requires scope 'contract' but the toolchain declares no contract scope.

context.note: Additive check only: no toolchain means no new findings. Existing scope/size validation unchanged.

features.name: Prove: pluggable test toolchain works end-to-end
features.behavior: A scaffolded target with test-toolchain.json runs init.mjs through the toolchain baseline, resolve-test-command returns correct commands, review-contract validates testScope, and survey-project detects the runner. Removing the toolchain falls back to stack detection.
features.verification: node tools/validate-toolchain.mjs --target . --check && node tools/resolve-test-command.mjs --scope unit --check && bash harness-loop/scripts/demo.sh
features.falsifier: The demo target's init.mjs ignores the toolchain and runs hardcoded commands, or resolve-test-command returns a command for a scope whose requires are not met, or review-contract accepts a testScope referencing an undeclared scope.

context.note: Prove counterpart for the six toolchain build features. Demo needs a fixture target with test-toolchain.json to exercise the full path. Design doc: docs/design/pluggable-test-toolchain.md.

evidence.result: Oracle được tạo với 6 điều kiện kiểm tra độc lập: schema validation, command resolution, baseline integration, feature scope validation, survey detection, và fallback behavior. Oracle phát hiện 5/6 thành phần chưa được triển khai, chỉ fallback behavior đang hoạt động.
